content.body:
The Brigade Map centers the view on the current city that the selected brigade is in. It also draws a line that connects the brigade to its parent division.
As with other maps, you can zoom and drag it as desired. You can also right-click on to bring up additional options. If you right-click in an open area, you can choose to center the map on your brigade or division. Right-clicking on a city allows you to also center the map on that city, or join a brigade in that city.
